# directmedia-mcp
> **FastMCP 2.13+ server for accessing Directmedia Publishing "Digitale Bibliothek" - TEXT EXTRACTION WORKING!** The Directmedia Publishing "Digitale Bibliothek" was a pioneering German electronic book ...

This project includes automated llms.txt generation for AI accessibility.
